title: Design System: Renal Relay Electric Type Studio, Light and Dark

body.purpose: Navigation, explanations, controls and patient data.

theme-control.purpose: Compact header control for switching the dashboard between light and dark themes.

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Short hover and color feedback on controls.

components.name: Retry Button
components.description: Lime action to reload an unavailable dashboard.
components.css: .ds-button { min-height: 43px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--lime); padding: 0 17px; color: var(--ink); font: 700 12px/1.4 var(--font-geist-sans), Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-button:hover { background: var(--lime-hover); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--lime); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Sticky product navigation with a theme switch and lime active underline.
components.html: <header class="ds-header"><nav class="ds-nav">…</nav><button class="ds-theme-toggle" type="button">Switch to dark mode</button></header>
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 36px; } .ds-nav a { border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: var(--paper-muted); font: 550 13px/1.4 var(--font-geist-sans), Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a.is-current { border-color: var(--lime); color: var(--paper); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--lime); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-theme-toggle { min-height: 40px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); padding: 0 11px; font: 600 12px/1.4 var(--font-geist-sans), Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; }

components.name: Workflow Panel
components.description: Cyan work surface with four numbered follow-through steps.
components.html:
The follow-through

components.css: .ds-workflow { border-radius: 12px; background: var(--cyan); padding: 32px; color: var(--ink); } .ds-workflow h2 { margin: 0; font: 480 30px/1.15 "Noto Serif Relay", Georgia, serif; } .ds-workflow ol { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 0 22px; margin: 24px 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-workflow li { display: flex; min-height: 60px; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; border-top: 1px solid var(--cyan-rule); padding: 10px 0; font: 580 13px/1.3 var(--font-geist-sans), Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-workflow li span { color: var(--cyan-muted); font: 10px/1.3 var(--font-geist-mono), monospace; }

narrative.overview: This system adapts Glyphs.app’s expressive type-studio character to a practical care-team workspace: oversized serif display, crisp sans-serif interface text, and confident blocks of electric lime and cyan. A compact header switch starts in light mode and lets staff move to the original night-black canvas. The light theme uses warm paper ground, dark ink, and the same tactile accent work surfaces; both themes preserve the task-first hierarchy. The dashboard introduces the follow-through path, shows current team counts, and then presents the live episode queue. It does not reproduce Glyphs’ software copy, type specimens, product images, or testimonials. The bundled Noto Serif variable font supplies the display voice; its OFL license is included in `public/fonts/OFL.txt`.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-paper shell by default, with a switch to the original night-black theme.
Lime for live workload and connected-state signals; cyan for the workflow sequence.
Near-white queue surface in light mode and warm paper in dark mode.
Only API-returned counts and episode rows are displayed.

rules.name: The Live-Data Rule
rules.body: Every summary measure and episode row comes from the dashboard API. An unavailable service never falls back to sample records or fabricated counts.

rules.name: The Contrast Rule
rules.body: Keep the large serif voice in headings. Use Geist for all labels, controls, and episode data.

dos: Do keep the display serif for section and hero headings; keep product controls and patient data in Geist.
Do use lime and cyan as broad, deliberate work surfaces, not as gradients.
Do keep each workflow step readable on desktop and mobile.
Do pair every colored state with text and preserve keyboard focus visibility.
Do render only live API data; distinguish service failure from a successful empty response.
donts: Don't add fictional names, sample counts, fabricated episodes, or demonstration banners.
Don't use marketing testimonials, mock product imagery, or controls unrelated to care-team work.
Don't hide service failure behind zero counts or an empty-queue message.
Don't imply diagnosis, interpretation of lab results, or automated clinical decisions.
